description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) "Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
According to this verse many churches do say, this prophecy is about the SDA because they do teach people to abstain from meat that God has blessed. 
Please how do you defend this?"
.
.
2.) "Dear Sir, I am confused when I listened to one black preacher from state regarding the Sabbath day of worship. His name is (BLANK) from the first church of Christ in which he was trying to explain that there is two Sabbaths. One is the OT Sabbath and the other is NT. Sabbath. The old Testament Sabbath leads to Canaan and the New Testament Sabbath leads to New Jerusalem and he goes on to say that he keep the Sabbath every day and he really discredited Seventh Day Adventist for keeping only one Sabbath which he said Sabbath at Moses times in the old Testament time and is finished. Can you explain what he is trying to preach here?
Thank you very much."
.
.
